analysis_protocol.bootstrap_statistic: median paired difference or median paired ratio

pairing.synthetic: problem seed, with the predeclared paired algorithm seed
pairing.real: algorithm seed on the fixed train/test split

analysis_protocol.conditional_median_rule: time/epochs/proxy to target medians are reported only among successful runs and always alongside success counts

H1_zero_oracle_pruning_failure.criterion: g3 median active-set fraction exceeds g1 on a majority of held-out problem families

H3_information_cost_is_regime_dependent.note: This is a descriptive check. The predeclared hypothesis permits mixed or one-sided outcomes.

predeclared_exact_information_can_someti.criterion: at least one held-out problem family has g1 success count no worse than g3 and paired median harmonized runtime ratio g1/g3 < 1
